subhead: Our own room, every Monday at the Log Cabin Bar & Grill in Olympia. Sign ups at 6, show at 7. Show up, go up.

poster.alt: Log Cabin Comedy Open Mic poster. The Stoned Goose lockup above the title, every Monday, sign ups 6 PM, show 7 PM, show up go up, at the Log Cabin Bar & Grill, 7035 Pacific Ave SE, Olympia, WA 98503.

howItWorks.heading: Sign ups at six.
howItWorks.body: Get to the Log Cabin at 6:00 PM and put your name down. That is the whole process. Show up, go up.

howItWorks.heading: Show at seven.
howItWorks.body: Two hours, 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM, every Monday. Bring the new material, the old material, or the bit that died last week.

howItWorks.heading: Then stay.
howItWorks.body: The comics who stick around for the rest of the list are the comics who get better. Work the room, watch the room.
